sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Roadmap: status symbols
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Shared #8 — Purpose: One ✅ ⏳ ~ ❌ set so humans and AI parse status the same way. When: docs / planning root. Adapt: use as-is unless the team already agreed different markers.
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
In roadmap, todo, and concept files always use:

✅ implemented
⏳ planned / open
~ evolved beyond original plan
❌ dropped / not relevant

Do not mix other markers — keeps docs readable for humans and AI.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Todos: ✅ ❌ + timestamp
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Shared #9 — Purpose: Open/done/dropped todos stay unambiguous with timestamps. When: docs root / shared progress tracking. Adapt: keep format; change nothing unless your todo file uses another convention.
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
In todo.md and agent replies for this project:

- Open: ⏳ Short description
- Done: ✅ Short description — YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
- Blocked/dropped: ❌ Short description — reason

Do not delete completed items — add a timestamp.
Prefix new tasks with ⏳.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Agent todos: ✅ ❌ in session
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Shared — Purpose: Same ✅ ❌ ⏳ rules inside agent session todo lists. When: teams that run long agent sessions. Adapt: use as-is; drop if you do not use session todos.
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
When updating todo lists in this agent session:

- Open tasks: ⏳ description
- Completed: ✅ description — YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
- Cancelled/blocked: ❌ description — reason

Mark done as soon as a task finishes.
Do not delete completed items — keep ✅ rows with timestamps.
Do not mix other status markers.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: New feature: write concept first
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Shared #6 — Purpose: Force concept → roadmap → todo before coding. When: docs / planning root for concept-driven teams. Adapt: rename concept/roadmap/todo paths if yours differ.
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Plan before implementation:

1) Create concept.<feature>.en.md (problem, goals, non-goals, data model, UX)
2) Add roadmap entry with status ⏳
3) Add concrete tasks to todo.md
4) Implement only after review

Status symbols: ✅ done · ⏳ open · ~ evolved · ❌ dropped

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Concept → todo.md
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Shared #7 — Purpose: Turn approved concepts into trackable tasks. When: docs root / PM–dev handoff. Adapt: link style to your todo file; keep the review gate.
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
After a concept is approved:

1) Extract concrete tasks into todo.md with ⏳ prefix
2) Link each task to the concept section it implements
3) Do not start coding until tasks exist and are reviewed
4) Mark concept roadmap entry ⏳ until all tasks are ✅ or ❌
